Premise: holds. At `origin/main` `f6f663a8`, `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS` holds the 13 names and nothing forward. `date-macros.zod.ts` already declares `next_month_start/end`, `next_quarter_start/end` and the parametric `{N_days_from_now}`. Core's half-open resolver (`analytics-date-range.ts`) ends `this_month` at `next_month_start`. Whether that end resolves is the measurement the ruling asks for first.
